title: Measuring Cross-Modal Synergy: A Benchmark for VLM Explainability
abstract: arXiv:2605.22168v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) map complex visual inputs to semantic spaces, but interpreting the cross-modal reasoning of VLMs currently relies on post-hoc explainers evaluated via unimodal perturbation metrics. We expose a limitation in this paradigm: because multimodal datasets contain language priors and modality biases, VLMs frequently exhibit cross-modal redundancy, allowing them to answer visual queries using text alone. Consequently, unimodal metrics penalize faithful explainers, triggering an evaluation collapse where visual and textual rankings fundamentally contradict each other. To resolve this, we introduce Synergistic Faithfulness ($\mathcal{F}_{syn}$), a scalable metric rooted in the Shapley Interaction Index that strictly isolates the joint Harsanyi dividend between modalities, serving as a highly accurate surrogate ($\rho = 0.93$) while achieving up to $88\times$ computational speedup. Evaluating 9 distinct XAI method

translated_title: 测量跨模态协同作用：VLM可解释性基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）将复杂的视觉输入映射到语义空间，但目前对VLM跨模态推理的解释依赖于事后解释器，并通过单模态扰动指标进行评估。我们揭示了这一范式的局限性：由于多模态数据集包含语言先验和模态偏差，VLM经常表现出跨模态冗余，使其能够仅凭文本回答视觉查询。因此，单模态指标会惩罚忠实的解释器，引发评估崩溃现象，即视觉和文本排名从根本上相互矛盾。为解决这一问题，我们提出了协同忠实度（Synergistic Faithfulness, F_syn），这是一种基于Shapley交互指数的可扩展指标，能够严格隔离模态间的联合Harsanyi红利，作为高精度替代指标（ρ = 0.93），同时实现高达88倍的计算加速。该指标被用于评估9种不同的可解释性（XAI）方法。
tldr: 该论文揭示了单模态扰动指标因VLM的跨模态冗余而引发评估崩溃的问题，并提出基于Shapley交互指数的协同忠实度指标F_syn，可在实现88倍计算加速的同时，高精度地量化解释器对跨模态协同效应的贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes an evaluation collapse in unimodal perturbation metrics caused by cross-modal redundancy in VLMs, and proposes Synergistic Faithfulness (F_syn), a Shapley Interaction Index-based metric that accurately quantifies explainers' contribution to cross-modal synergy with up to 88× computational speedup.
